thesis: Finite responsibility needs a multidimensional map, repair and learning rather than automatic scores or limitless sacrifice.

ideas.statement: Capacity, knowledge, connection, role, power, cost and affected voices must be considered without mechanical aggregation.
Protection, fact-finding, repair, forgiveness, punishment and reintegration have distinct purposes.
Learning institutions and supported education coexist with an intrinsically valuable private life.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: An inaccessible automated assistance application distributes distinct tasks to applicant, official, manager, researcher and citizen.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The map is not a validated score; reparations cannot erase every loss.

audit.notes: All assigned units read. Claims remain bounded; hypothetical cases are not empirical evidence.
